subject: Onboarding checklist: Non-US vendor invoicing, VAT/GST evidence, and PO entity mapping
messages:
From: Alina Petrov <alina.petrov@novamarine.com>
To: k.nguyen@redwood.com (karthik_iyer)
Cc: Jose Ramirez <jose.ramirez@tecnologica.mx>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:23:00-05:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: VAT cert + invoice formatting questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. We're excited to onboard as a Redwood supplier. Two quick items before we raise invoices:

1) We operate in the EU through Novamarine BV (VAT NL) and in India through Novamarine India Pvt Ltd (GSTIN 29ABCDE1234F1Z5). Which legal entity should receive the PO for software/subscription vs logistics services?

2) Can you confirm whether Redwood needs a single invoice per PO or if we should split invoices by legal entity (EUR invoice from NL entity + INR invoice from India)? Our accounting system can issue split invoices but we want to align with your AP.

Attached: novamarine_vat_cert_EU.pdf, novamarine_sample_invoice_EUR.pdf, novamarine_bank_details.pdf

Appreciate guidance and we can assemble any additional tax residency attestation or WHT forms if needed.

Thanks,
Alina Petrov
Head of Finance, Novamarine Logistics
+44 20 7946 0123

From: k.nguyen@redwood.com (karthik_iyer)
To: Alina Petrov <alina.petrov@novamarine.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: VAT cert + invoice formatting questions

Hi Alina — thanks for the attachments and the clear questions. Short answers and next steps below.

Summary guidance:
- Redwood requires each PO to reference a single legal vendor record. For tax and entity-level reporting we prefer separate vendor records per legal entity (Novamarine BV and Novamarine India). That means:
  - If the PO is for EU-registered services/products billed by Novamarine BV (VAT NL), route PO to the BV entity.
  - If it's for India-local services or expenses billed by Novamarine India Pvt Ltd, route PO to the India entity.
- For platform/subscription fees where the customer (Redwood) is outside the supplier's country, we rely on the supplier's VAT decision (reverse charge vs standard VAT) and supporting VAT certificate.

Action items for Novamarine (can send as attachments or a single zip):
1) Copy of VAT registration (you already sent novamarine_vat_cert_EU.pdf) — good.
2) Sample invoice per entity showing VAT/GST lines (we have novamarine_sample_invoice_EUR.pdf). Please also send an India GST invoice sample.
3) Bank details per entity (we have novamarine_bank_details.pdf). Make sure the beneficiary name matches the legal entity on the PO.
4) Fill our tax onboarding form (redwood_tax_onboarding_form.csv) — link below. This captures tax residency, WHT exposure, and whether a supplier requests reverse-charge treatment.

Cc'ing Laura (AP lead) and Vivek (tax) to confirm AP routing and whether we'd need a tax residency attestation or local WHT forms.

I will draft a PO while we confirm entity mapping; please aim to return the India invoice sample and the completed onboarding form by EOD Thursday so we can cut the PO next week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Alina Petrov <alina.petrov@novamarine.com>
To: k.nguyen@redwood.com (karthik_iyer)
Cc: Jose Ramirez <jose.ramirez@tecnologica.mx>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: VAT cert + invoice formatting questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — attached are the India GST invoice sample and a completed quick version of the tax onboarding CSV. Files: novamarine_sample_invoice_INR.pdf, redwood_tax_onboarding_form_completed.csv (attached).

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- For subscription/platform revenue (SaaS) billed from NL entity to Redwood US, our typical treatment is to invoice from Novamarine BV (no VAT charged on exports) and provide NL VAT certificate.
- For local on-the-ground services in India, we invoice from Novamarine India Pvt Ltd with GST applied (local tax).
- Bank beneficiary names match each legal entity; please ensure PO entity matches beneficiary on the invoice to avoid payment delays.

If Redwood prefers a single PO and split-payment approach (one PO -> two invoices), we can do that but need explicit mapping so AP posts lines to the correct vendor record.

Let us know if you want us to prepare separate vendor registrations now or wait for the first PO.

Best,
Alina

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: k.nguyen@redwood.com (karthik_iyer)
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, Alina Petrov <alina.petrov@novamarine.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T14:02:00-05:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: VAT cert + invoice formatting questions

Hi all,

Thanks for the clear attachments, Alina. A few AP-level requirements so we avoid delays at payment:

1) Vendor records: please create two vendor records in our system (Novamarine BV - NL, Novamarine India Pvt Ltd - IN). Each must have the correct legal name and bank account. We cannot post invoices for one legal entity to a different vendor record.

2) Invoice format:
- Mandatory fields: invoice date, invoice number, supplier legal name, supplier VAT/GST registration number, Redwood PO number, currency, itemized line descriptions, net amount, tax amount (VAT or GST), gross amount, and bank details.
- For EU invoices where reverse-charge applies, include the clause: "VAT reverse-charge applies - article 44/196 of Council Directive" or similar, and the buyer VAT (Redwood's VAT not required but helpful).

3) Split PO guidance:
- Preferred (cleanest): issue separate POs per legal entity. This avoids accounting split entries and WHT complexity.
- Allowed (if necessary): single PO with split invoicing. If you choose this, include in each invoice a top-level field "Billable Entity: Novamarine BV" or "Billable Entity: Novamarine India Pvt Ltd" so AP can route lines to the correct vendor ID.

4) Tax documents: Vivek — please confirm if we need a tax residency attestation for Novamarine BV to support zero-rating on exports.

Vivek, any additional tax docs we should request? Alina, once you upload the completed onboarding CSV to the Drive link below and confirm separate vendor names, Laura will send the PO.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1TaxOnboardForm
Proc ticket: PROC-1123

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference

Alina — thanks for the quick turnaround and the samples. Next steps:

1) Please upload the completed onboarding CSV to the Drive link and re-send the India invoice sample as PDF (we couldn't open the embedded CSV preview).
2) Confirm whether you want separate POs per legal entity (recommended). If yes, we'll issue:
   - PO-2026-RWI-8897 -> Novamarine BV (EUR, subscription)
   - PO-2026-RWI-8898 -> Novamarine India Pvt Ltd (INR, local services)
3) I'll attach a draft PO (draft_po_RWI-2026-8897.pdf) for review; Laura will finalize once vendor records are created.

Target timeline: vendor records + final invoices by EOD Monday (2026-11-08) -> PO issuance Tuesday. If you need earlier payment terms, flag when you upload bank instructions.

Thanks again — cc'ing Laura to confirm once vendor records are created so we can finalize PO-2026-RWI-8897.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
